column1: # Corpus-trap baseline for tests/v06_corpus_trap_report.rs's four
# corpus-invariant tests over `data/corpus/**` (audit_ingested_cache).
# Format: trap_id<TAB>count<TAB>note
# trap_id is the stable `Trap::id()` string; count is the exact number of
# `Finding`s of that trap the live corpus carries.
# Every row here is SD-33's already-verified, already-out-of-DoD inherited
# debt (`../release/SD-34-book-completion/forward-scope-register.md` D1.1's
# `v06_corpus_trap_report` target; ruled on in
# `../release/SD-34-book-completion/decisions.md` §13). §13: "AT-34-E1-008's
# bar is `wiring-class-mismatch = 0`, with the other four trap kinds
# reported at their unchanged counts" — these four rows are that unchanged
# count, registered so a test asserting `violations.is_empty()` (informative
# never, since it is red forever against known debt) can instead assert
# "the live count equals its registered baseline" (informative always: it
# fails the moment either side moves).
# The bar is symmetric, exactly as `pi_sweep_rules_tables` / `pi-sweep`
# already enforces it in this repo (`src/rules_core/pi_table_sweep.rs`):
# a live count ABOVE its row is an unbaselined regression (AT-34-E1-008's
# `wiring-class-mismatch = 0` scope is these four kinds' sibling, not these
# four themselves — a live increase here is still a hard stop, not silently
# absorbed into that other bar) and a live count BELOW its row is a stale
# row (the debt shrank — driving it further to zero remains
# AT-34-E1-008's scope per `decisions.md` §13, not this file's to
# celebrate quietly; update the row deliberately when it happens).
# Derived 2026-09-01 by
# `cargo test --locked --test v06_corpus_trap_report <test_name> -- --nocapture 2>&1 | grep -c "Finding {"`,
# one command per row, re-confirming wave-24/26's own identical figures
# exactly (`artifacts/epic-6-closure/AT-34-E6-001_gate-lane-a_wave26_cycle_receipt.md`).
